# Foundation corpus

These are tiny original ZIP fixtures, not complete EPUB publications. See
[independent-python.md](independent-python.md) for their contents and provenance.
Additional synthetic stored/Deflate ZIPs are built in zip_archive_test.dart.
Security tests mutate the independent fixture to test each malformed condition.

Original EPUB fixtures are in [epub](epub/README.md). Selected W3C EPUB 3 tests
are vendored in [w3c](w3c/README.md) under the W3C Software and Document License;
see [NOTICE](w3c/NOTICE.md). All other fixtures are original.
